## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; sector-level strength in Energy/Materials/Industrials contrasts with multiple large-cap Tech names BELOW TREND, creating mixed signals; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) and style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.53% | 1M: +10.23%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.76% | 1M: +16.19%), PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.76% | 1M: +3.71%). Materials strong: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.86% | 1M: +13.39%). Industrials advancing: EMR ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.39% | 1M: +5.83%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication lagging: NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -6.47%). Real Estate weak: CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -5.84%). Utilities modestly negative at sector level (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +0.30%) with no clear SP100 leader this week.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.53% | 1M: +10.23%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.76% | 1M: +16.19%), PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.76% | 1M: +3.71%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +2.01%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.86% | 1M: +13.39%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) — cyclical/commodity skew.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -0.02%), KHC BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -4.41%), NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -6.47%), CSCO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -5.71%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -16.95%). Weakness concentrated in select Tech/Comm names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W momentum: VLO (1W: +17.53% | 1M: +10.23%), SLB (1W: +15.76% | 1M: +16.19%), INTC (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +2.01%). Note MAJOR divergence across mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA showing persistent BELOW TREND) — treat as tactical setups, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed internals: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -6.78%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -2.63%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.78% | 1M: -0.27%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +3.74%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.59% | 1M: +5.03%); sector shows short-term dispersion across leaders and laggards (19 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.81% | 1M: +5.10%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +7.77%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +7.33%); sector breadth positive (20 stocks) and supportive for cyclical exposure.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare steady: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +7.18%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.78%), JNJ showing TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +2.05%); defensive names mixed but sector positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclical/commodity-exposed names and select Industrials/Financials given narrow Energy leadership and solid sector breadth; reduce exposure to idiosyncratic large-cap Tech names showing BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) and Communication laggards (NFLX). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — remain selective.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.53% | 1M: +10.23%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.76% | 1M: +16.19%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +7.18%). BEARISH: ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -0.02%), NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -6.47%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -6.78%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +6.26%, 8 stocks), Materials (1W: +6.54% | 1M: +13.04%), Industrials (1W: +5.01% | 1M: +6.92%). BEARISH: Communication (1W: -1.08% | 1M: +1.15%), Real Estate (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +0.26%).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch whether Energy leaders sustain momentum after outsized 1W gains (VLO/SLB must hold recent breakout momentum); monitor AAPL and MSFT for further downside confirmation below this week’s lows as that would deepen tech weakness; watch JPM and UNH for continuation above recent 1M strength as confirmation of broader cyclical support.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ISRG (+80): FDA/da Vinci usage headlines — cross-ref price action not in top lists, monitor for confirmation. RTX (+60): defense budget headlines — sector confirming Industrials strength (DE/BA strong this week). UPS (+55): margin-focused earnings beat — positive sentiment may be diverging vs other freight concerns; watch price follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
SBUX (-90): Chapter 11 headline — sentiment extreme and price not in top lists, significant downside risk if confirmed. GM (-65): large charge headline — confirms auto-sector headline risk despite some consumer discretionary winners. ADBE (-50): downgrade headline and ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -0.02%) — sentiment confirming recent weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership given broad sector breadth but concentrated top-performer bias toward Energy. VLO, SLB, PSX ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while AAPL, MSFT, NVDA are showing weakness/BELOW TREND. Key risk: major-cap Tech dispersion and several headline-driven sentiment risks (SBUX, GM, ADBE) create transitional market conditions — watch for trend confirmation.
